lines.text: What if making a video was as simple as writing a web page?
lines.visual_hint: Pip at the workbench, a screen showing code on one side, a video frame on the other

lines.text: No timeline. No dragging clips. Just code.
lines.visual_hint: Pip pushes an imaginary timeline away

lines.text: Remotion gives you a frame number and a blank canvas.
lines.visual_hint: real docs page: the core idea sentence

lines.text: One hook, use current frame, tells you where you are.
Change what you draw on each frame, and you have an animation.
Set the size, the speed and the length, and it knows the whole video.
Then npx remotion render turns the code into an MP4.
Over seventy thousand people have starred it on GitHub.
A video is just a function of time, and you already write functions.
Comment REMOTION and I will send you the docs link.
Save this for your next project.
